a: Ye mubuulizi asinga bonna Ekkanisa ey'edda be yakuza. "Chrysostom" kigambo kya Luyonaani ekitegeeza "omumwa ogwa zaabu," erinnya Ekkanisa lye yamuwa oluvannyuma, kubanga okumala emyaka kkumi n'omukaaga mu Antioch n'omukaaga mu Constantinople abantu baajjuza amakanisa okuwuliriza omusajja omutono, omukovvu, era eyeefiiriza, ng'annyonnyola Bayibuli olunyiriri ku lunyiriri, era tebaakoowanga kumuwuliriza. Era ye mubuulizi Ekkanisa gwe yagoba mu buwaŋŋanguse, n'emutwala mu lugendo olw'okufa okuyita mu Asia Minor, n'oluvannyuma, ng'emyaka amakumi asatu mu gumu giyiseewo nga kikeereye nnyo, n'emuzza eka mu kitiibwa.

Kitaawe, eyali omukungu mu ggye lya Suuli, yafa John ng'akyali mwana muto, era nnyina Anthusa n'asigala nnamwandu ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri. Yagaana buli eyamusaba okumufumbirwa, era n'akuza mutabani we ne muwala we yekka, bulungi nnyo ne kirabikira buli muntu, olwo omwogezi ow'abakaafiiri asingira ddala mu mulembe ogwo, Libanius, bwe yawulira ebimukwatako, n'aleekaana nti: "Laba, abakazi ab'ekitalo nga bwe basangibwa mu Bakristaayo!"

Anthusa yawa mutabani we okuyigirizibwa okusinga obulungi ssente kwe zaasobola okugula — Libanius yennyini, John gwe yafuukira omuyizi asinga bonna — era n'ayingira mu mbuga z'amateeka, omuwozi omulungi gye yandyambuse okutuuka ku kifo kya prefect oba consul. Ekyakimenya kwe kwonoona okwa bulijjo okw'omulimu ogwo: okukkiriza empeera olw'okufuula ensonga embi okulabika ennungi kye yalowooza ng'okukkiriza empeera ya Setaani. Yabatizibwa mu myaka gye egy'amakumi abiri egisooka, era n'ayagala okugenda amangwago eri abamonaki abaali ku nsozi.

Nnyina n'amuziyiza. Yamutwala mu kisenge mwe yazaalirwa, n'amutuuza ku ludda lw'ekitanda, n'amusaba ekintu kimu: obutamufuula nnamwandu omulundi ogwokubiri. Yasigala, ennyumba n'agifuula ekifo ky'abamonaki — ng'alya bitono, ng'asula wansi ku ttaka, era ng'agolokoka mu kiro okusaba. Anthusa bwe yamala okufa, olwo n'agenda ku nsozi, era eyo emyaka ena wansi w'omumonaki omukadde n'emyaka ebiri emirala ng'ali yekka mu mpuku byayonoona obulamu bwe olubeerera.

q: Homilies on the Statues byali ki?
a: Mu biseera bya spring mu 387, omusolo omuggya gwaleeta akeegugungo mu Antioch, era ekibiina ky'abantu ne kiwanula ebifaananyi eby'ekikomo eby'omukama ne babiwalulira mu nguudo. Ekibuga bwe kyeddamu amagezi ne kitegeera nti kiyinza okuzikirizibwa. Mu ntiisa eyo, Chrysostom yabuulira ebibuulirwa amakumi abiri mu kimu mu kiseera kya Lent, ng'anyweza buli lunaku ekibiina ekyali mu kutya, ng'omulabirizi Flavian agenze okwegayirira omukama — eyawa okusonyiyibwa, akabi ne kafuuka omukisa eri Ekkanisa.

q: Ekitabo kye ekikwata ku bwakabona kiri kitya?
a: Kyawandiikibwa nga mboozi n'omukwano gwe Basil, era kikyali ekitabo ekinoonyereza ennyo okusinga ebirala ku buweereza obw'obusumba Ekkanisa ey'edda kye yakola. Endowooza yaakyo eri nti omulimu guzitowa nnyo, era emmeeme y'oyo agukola eri mu bulabe bungi, n'olwekyo okugudduka kuyinza okuba eky'amagezi okusingira ddala — era kyawandiikibwa omuntu eyali agudduseeko ye kennyini. Kyava mu myaka gye egy'omu Antioch, obuzito bwe yannyonnyola nga tebunnamugwako mu mazima.

q: Lwaki obuweereza bwe mu Constantinople bwamufunira abalabe?
a: Yalondebwa okugenda mu kibuga ekikulu mu 397 nga tabuuziddwa, era n'aggibwa mu Antioch ng'akuumibwa abaserikale, n'abuulira eyo nga bwe yali abuulidde mu Antioch — ku by'okwemalira, omululu, n'abaavu abaalagajjalirwa — mu kibuga nga ennyumba ya nnabagereka Eudoxia mwe byonna ebisatu byabeereranga. Yakendeeza ku nsimbi z'ennyumba y'obulabirizi okutuusa lwe zaggwaawo, n'atunda ebintu eby'omu lubiri n'effeeza y'ekkanisa okuzimba amalwaliro, era n'akangavvula abakabona abaali beeyagaza. Baamulabula, naye n'aweeyongera.

q: Kiki ekyaliwo mu Lukiiko lw'e Oak?
a: Mu 403 Theophilus ow'e Alexandria yajja n'abakuumi, n'akuŋŋaanya abalabirizi amakumi asatu mu mukaaga, abasinga obungi nga b'e Misiri, emitala wa Bosphorus, era n'aleetera Chrysostom okuggyibwa ku bufuzi nga taliiwo ku misango amakumi abiri mu mwenda — omuli obulyake, okulya yekka, n'okuyita nnabagereka Jezebel. Yagaana okulabika mu mbuga eyali ejjuvu abamulwanyisa, era teyakkiriza kibuga kimulwanirire, n'awaayo yekka eri abaserikale; naye Constantinople n'esasaana, era musisi ow'ekiro ekyo n'atiisa nnyo Eudoxia, ne bamuzzaawo okumala akaseera katono.

Obuwaŋŋanguse obwokubiri, mu 404, bwe bwali obw'enkomerero. Bwe yaweerezebwa e Cucusus ku nsozi z'e Armenia, yeeyongera okuwandiika — mwe muli ebbaluwa kkumi na musanvu eri dikoni omukazi Olympias, n'ekitabo ekiwakanya nti tewali n'omu ayinza kutuusibwako kabi wabula ye yennyini. Bwe yalagirwa okuweerezebwa mu kifo ekisinga obubi mu bwakabaka, abakuumi baatwala omusajja omulwadde ow'emyaka nkaaga ng'atambula n'ebigere okumala emyezi esatu; teyatuukayo, n'afa nga 14 September 407 okumpi ne Comana ng'alina ku mimwa gye ekigambo kye eky'obulamu: "Katonda atenderezebwe olwa buli kintu."

q: Yaddizibwa atya ekitiibwa kye, era kiki kye yaleka?
a: Emyaka amakumi asatu mu gumu oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwe, mu 438, omulambo gwe gwazzibwa e Constantinople ne guteekebwa wansi w'ekyoto wakati w'abakama ne bapatriaka; omukama omuto Theodosius II ne mwannyina Pulcheria, abaana ba Eudoxia, baasisinkana essanduuko y'omulambo ne bafukamira mu maaso gaayo, ne basaba eggulu okusonyiyibwa mu linnya lya bazadde baabwe. Okubuulira kwa Chrysostom okwatutuukako kusinga obungi okwa kitaawe w'Ekkanisa Omuyonaani omulala yenna, kubanga abantu baakuwandiikanga ng'akyayogera — musome okusookera ddala olw'eddoboozi lye, erikkiriza nti omuntu ali mu maaso ge ayinza okukyuka.
